name: mounts
lore:
A mount is no mere engine of travel; it is a heartbeat beneath your saddle. Whether the common horse or the exotic beast, these creatures are governed by ancient instincts. The horse, a creature of the herd, remains hyper-vigilant—its ears twitching at the snap of a twig or the scent of a predator long before your own wits register the threat.

In contrast, the griffon remains a territorial hunter, viewing its rider as a packmate rather than a master. The giant lizard, cold and patient, navigates the lightless depths with a stoic, primal focus. To ride is to forge a silent pact: you provide the provender; they provide the speed. Respect their nature, for in the untamed wilds, a mount’s sudden agitation is often the only warning you will receive before steel must be drawn. Handle them with steady hands, and they shall carry you home.
